name: Rust DSN parser and PCB router

mentions.name: Rust DSN parser and PCB router
mentions.description: A PCB design toolchain written in Rust: a finished DSN parser and a planned PCB router, with a wasm/wasi build planned so that PCB routing can run in the browser.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just finished a dsn parser and now I am planning to write a pcb router. All in rust. The plan is to have a wasm/wasi version as well so routing is possible in the browser.
